review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for C. The PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical benchmark input, retains humanConfirmed=false, and makes only the selected branch required; an empty human-decision input is therefore consistent with expectedReadiness=ready. This does not waive the requirement that a materially unresolved DEC-001 block B at decisions. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, and the task keys agree across the specification and Gold. The supplied source establishes core/api.ts as the shared stringbool implementation used by classic and mini, supporting the exact three-file writable scope while treating forwarding and declaration consumers as inspection owners. The build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY must each cover all required acceptance criteria, including construction-time TypeError, normalization boundaries without added trimming, and unchanged non-overlap and codec behavior. The allowed assignees have the appropriate distinct delivery roles, available slots, and supplied active trusted capability claims; pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. The selected planning reviewer is consistent with the supplied reviewer-selection policy. Gold and preview release fingerprints match, and the supplied provenance explains the different manifest, normalized PRD, and evaluation-source digest domains. The original preparation-time runnable=false and remaining-work fields are not the readiness result expected from the frozen planning input. This approval relies on the supplied Service-calculated bindings and review evidence, not independent digest recomputation, code execution, candidate results, or a new human attestation; it does not authorize task dispatch or establish execution-environment readiness.
